entity_type_descs.agent_role: A functional role in a multi-agent workflow, such as portfolio manager (PM), bull/bear debater, or calibrated compaction judge.
entity_type_descs.cli_agent: Any command-line coding agent that can act as a worker under admission control and trust-ladder supervision.
entity_type_descs.compaction_decision: A keep-or-drop judgment over agent context content, made semantically rather than by character count.
entity_type_descs.diary_entry: An append-only markdown record written per settled turn into a local git repository, containing tool mix, event mix, closing words, duration, and end reason.
entity_type_descs.dsh_plugin: A DeepSeek Harness plugin repository in the vicfei family, such as dsh-ai-hedge-fund, dsh-auto-ontology, dsh-CCXT, or dsh-compaction-semantic.
entity_type_descs.evidence_tag: A source quote or citation attached to a claim, entity, or relation, enforcing the family's no-evidence-no-assertion discipline.
entity_type_descs.format_spec: An executable schema or FORMAT.md document describing a reverse-engineered file format, carrying a verification status such as verified-byte-equal, semantic-equal, or hypothesis.
entity_type_descs.git_repository: A user-owned local git repo (GitHub/Gitea/bare) where plugins persist diary entries or evidence ledgers.
entity_type_descs.guardrail: A fail-closed safety mechanism enforced in code, such as the triple-armed trading guard with notional caps and symbol whitelist.
entity_type_descs.harness_event: A durable event emitted by the DeepSeek Harness session/event stream, such as turn/end, session/disposed, blocked, interrupted, or forked.
entity_type_descs.harness_service: A named, optional service slot in the DeepSeek Harness engine, such as the tool-result pruner resolved by name.
entity_type_descs.investor_persona: A named investor archetype (Buffett, Munger, Lynch, Wood) that independently values a ticker within the hedge-fund committee.
entity_type_descs.ledger_entry: A hash-chained JSON row in the evidence ledger recording a session transition with id, ts, kind, payload, prevHash, and entryHash.
entity_type_descs.market_data_payload: A read-only data record returned from an exchange or data source, carrying its source and timestamp.
entity_type_descs.ontology_component: A structural element of a constructed ontology, such as an entity type, relation type, TBox, or ABox.
entity_type_descs.output_artifact: A produced deliverable with a defined format, such as an IC-MEMO, a typed ontology (TBox+ABox), or a compaction result.
entity_type_descs.profile: A harness installation profile (e.g. web, default) that determines which plugins are loaded.
entity_type_descs.roundtrip_gate: The verification step that decodes a sample, re-encodes it, and compares byte-for-byte to classify format knowledge.
entity_type_descs.ticket: An approval artifact used in admission control, e.g. a WeChat single-digit approval that authorizes an agent action.
entity_type_descs.trust_ladder: The admission-control progression (off → observe → auto) governing whether and how autonomously a CLI agent may start work.
entity_type_descs.type_conflict: An organically detected inconsistency between ontology types that is flagged rather than silently dropped.
entity_type_descs.upstream_project: An external open-source project that a dsh plugin is inspired by, built on, or implements the concept of, e.g. virattt/ai-hedge-fund, NVIDIA/auto-ontology, ccxt.

relation_type_descs.inspired_by: A dsh plugin is inspired by or implements the concept of an upstream project.
relation_type_descs.built_on: A dsh plugin is technically built on an upstream library or project.
relation_type_descs.sister_of: Two dsh plugins belong to the same family and are cross-referenced as sister projects.
relation_type_descs.has_persona: A hedge-fund plugin includes named investor personas that value tickers independently.
relation_type_descs.has_role: A plugin defines agent roles that participate in its workflow.
relation_type_descs.produces: A plugin appends a hash-chained ledger entry per session transition.
relation_type_descs.carries_evidence: An output artifact attaches evidence tags to its claims, entities, or relations.
relation_type_descs.enforces: A plugin enforces a fail-closed guardrail in its bridge code.
relation_type_descs.returns: A market-data plugin returns payloads annotated with exchange and timestamp.
relation_type_descs.contains: A constructed ontology artifact contains entity types, relation types, TBox and ABox components.
relation_type_descs.flags: An ontology plugin detects and flags type conflicts instead of silently dropping them.
relation_type_descs.makes: A calibrated judge role makes semantic keep-or-drop decisions over context.
relation_type_descs.resolves: A plugin fills an optional name-based service slot in the harness engine.
relation_type_descs.subscribes_to: A plugin listens to a harness event stream such as session/event.
relation_type_descs.writes_entry_to: A plugin appends diary or ledger entries into a user-owned git repository.
relation_type_descs.triggered_by: A diary entry is created when a settled turn/end event with a completing reason is emitted.
relation_type_descs.chains_to: Each ledger entry references the previous entry's hash, forming a tamper-evident chain.
relation_type_descs.governs: The trust ladder determines the autonomy level granted to a CLI agent.
relation_type_descs.authorizes: A ticket grants approval for an agent to start or continue work.
relation_type_descs.verified_by: A format spec's knowledge status is established by passing the roundtrip gate.
relation_type_descs.installs_into: A plugin is installed into a specific harness profile such as web or default.
